page.overview:
Who is Chang Squik?

Chang Squik was an assassin of Clan Eshin that had served as an apprentice beneath Deathmaster Snikch. He formed a triad with his clan-brethrens Chang Kritch and Chang Fang, the former having committed ritual suicide following the disgrace of Chang Squik, whilst the latter sought vengeance against the Rat responsibile for their fall from grace.

Raised and trained in Cathay, Chang was trained since birth in the way of the Assassin. Since being a runt, he had been made to run over white-hot coals bare-pawed and steal coins from beggars in the cities. In time, he became a master of unarmed combat, rising to the third degree in the way of the Crimson Talon and a black belt in the Path of the Deadly Paw. After months in the eastern jungles and meditating on Mount Yellowfang with only his own droppings as food, he was ready to serve the Council of Thirteen. One of his most famous kills had been the assassination of Lord Khijaw of Clan Gulcher when the latter had become a threat to Throt the Unclean.

Chang Squik was sent to Nuln in the Empire to aid in its conquest under Clan Skab. Under command of Grey Seer Thanquol, he was to assassinate the duo Gotrek and Felix. The plan failed, and Chang had to report this failure to his superior. When the assault on Nuln was to begin, Chang was to aid Thanquol in taking the nobles and Elector-Countess Emmanuelle von Liebwitz captive. As there was a masque ball, the nobles believed Chang to merely wear a very elaborate costume. When Grey Seer Thanquol arrived and demanded to be handed the “chief-breeder”, he blasted Chang with warp lightning when targeting nobles. Of course, Thanquol knew it was him all along. Just another lose end for Thanquol to tie up.
